batting.label: HR leaders
batting.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_batting_stats s JOIN players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.season = {season} AND s.at_bats >= 50 ORDER BY s.home_runs DESC LIMIT 5

batting.label: OPS leaders
batting.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_batting_stats s JOIN players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.season = {season} AND s.at_bats >= 100 ORDER BY s.ops DESC LIMIT 5

batting.label: AVG leaders
batting.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_batting_stats s JOIN players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.season = {season} AND s.at_bats >= 100 ORDER BY s.batting_avg DESC LIMIT 5

batting.label: SB leaders
batting.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_batting_stats s JOIN players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.season = {season} AND s.at_bats >= 50 ORDER BY s.stolen_bases DESC LIMIT 5

pitching.label: W leaders
pitching.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_pitching_stats sp JOIN players p ON sp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE sp.season = {season} AND sp.games_started >= 5 ORDER BY sp.wins DESC LIMIT 5

pitching.label: SO leaders
pitching.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_pitching_stats sp JOIN players p ON sp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE sp.season = {season} AND sp.games_started >= 5 ORDER BY sp.strikeouts DESC LIMIT 5

pitching.label: ERA leaders
pitching.sql: SELECT p.name FROM season_pitching_stats sp JOIN players p ON sp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE sp.season = {season} AND sp.games_started >= 10 ORDER BY sp.era ASC LIMIT 5
